scope: App-private Linux process, wait protocol, and Home idle gate

checks: Normal worker exit status reaches the original waiter
First waiter settles while worker PID, birth, and direct parent remain stable
Uncatchable waiter retirement leaves the same direct parent and live worker
Catchable cancellation waits for worker cleanup
Guardian loss delivers parent-death cleanup to the worker

idle_conditions_verified: Repeated unadmitted connections preserve the initial deadline
Exit, USB, and a new sleep event cancel even with a ready connection
Owner peer loss interrupts an idle wait
Low available memory is resampled without a visit
Unknown or malformed memory information fails closed
